FOREWORD

0.1 This Indian Standard ( Part 3 ) was adopted by the Indian Standards lnstitution on 5 October 1984, after the draft finalized by Illuminating Engineering and Luminaires Sectional Committee had been approved by the Electrotechnical Division Council. 0.2 This standard is intended to deal with the specific requirements The standard has been developed of inset approach lighting fittings. workmanship and test with a view to ensure good design, high quality procedures so that the fittings provide reliable service in actual field application under low visibiiny conditions. 0.3 This standard is one among the series being developed for inset t\pe `l'his of lighting installations to be provided at airports in this country. series consists of the following parts: Part 1 General requirements centre and tests fittings

Part 2 Runway Part 3 Approach Part 4 Touch 0.4 This standard. standard, includes fittings.

1. SCOPE 1.1 This standard (Part 3 ) specifies the photometric performance and the essential mechanical and electrical requirements ( excluding lamps ) of inset type approach lighting fittings to be installed in runway pavements.

4.2 The inset approach lighting fittings ( approach centre line lights, approach side row lights and threshold lights ) shall be of uni-directional type and shall emit a light beam in the direction of approach.
